header.title: Exploratory test: column summaries on slow sources
header.result: Column summaries load and pause on schedule. **A column over 10 s never loads, and Continue loads the wrong columns.**
header.tested: the summary panel on pandas and a slow source, 4 scenarios

details.title: Change under test
details.body: The column-profile request timeout drops from 60 s to 10 s, with paced loading and a Retry notice.

details.title: State manipulation
details.body: `slow.py` makes each value's hash sleep, standing in for a large or remote table.

details.title: Branch verification
details.body: Grepped `out/` for "Summaries paused"; present only on this branch.

findings.title: A column over 10 s never loads, and Retry cannot help

steps.text: Run `one12 = make_slow(ncols=1, nrows=1000, delay=0.012)`. One string column whose frequency table takes about 13 s.

steps.observed: Loading dots, then "Some summaries unavailable. Retry"; the sparkline slot empties.

log.body:
Error: get_column_profiles timed out after 10 seconds
  at DataExplorerClient.getColumnProfiles (languageRuntimeDataExplorerClient.ts:212)
  at TableSummaryCache.loadColumnProfiles (tableSummaryCache.ts:538)
  at TableSummaryCache.retryColumnProfiles (tableSummaryCache.ts:611)

steps.text: Click Retry and wait 15 s. Repeat once.

findings.observed: The summary never loads; the panel shows "Some summaries unavailable. Retry", and Retry shows it again.
findings.expected: The summary loads, or Retry loads it.

evidence.caption: The notice on a one-column frame
The notice on a twelve-column frame

findings.title: Continue loads off-screen columns, not the visible ones

steps.text: Run `slow80 = make_slow(ncols=80, nrows=1000, delay=0.002)`, then `%view slow80`.
Wait about 35 s until "Summaries paused. Continue" appears.
Scroll the summary panel to the bottom (s62 to s79 visible), click Continue and wait until "Summaries paused." returns (32 s).
The visible columns s62 to s79 get sparklines.
Scroll the summary panel up by about one screen.
Continue spent its budget on the visible columns, not the ones above them.
steps.observed: s49 to s61, off-screen when Continue was pressed, got sparklines.

findings.observed: After Continue, the visible columns stay empty while columns above them load.
findings.expected: Continue loads the columns on screen first.

evidence.caption: Columns above the fold loaded instead
